messages:
evan: Heads up — after rolling zephyr-lite-2.7b (4-bit q4) to canary ~10% last night, we're seeing a cluster of math/hallucination failures and a latency bump in eu-west :warning:

mira: :eyes: can you paste a quick repro and which evals are regressing?

evan: repro below — short arithmetic prompts return nonsense or repeat tokens, CPU decode time up ~2x for seq_len=512 in traces:

```
prompt: 'What is 128 * 63?'
model_out: '128 times 63 equals 8000... 8000...'
trace: gpu_kernel_decode_ms=45 -> 110, kv_cache_hitrate=0.92 -> 0.91
```

sasha: I ran a tiny loop locally, repros for me too but only on 4-bit q4 build. q8 and fp16 look fine. attaching a tiny script:
```bash
for i in 1..50; do echo "What is $((RANDOM%200*RANDOM%100))?" | curl -s -X POST ...; done
```

mira: interesting — could be quant rounding or scale clip. any differences in tokenizer or padding?

evan: tokenizer same. model graph changed: we applied per-channel scales + new fused attention kernel in this build. ops-bot: canary ramp at 10% -> paused on manual flag by @evan at 1978501260.

kelly: FYI this affected a handful of paying customers on eu-west, not widespread but noticed in logs. recommend fallback route to q8 for now to limit impact :hammer:

sasha: quick experiment idea: re-run with per-tensor instead of per-channel scales and/or disable fused attention to isolate. I'll spin an isolated canary in us-east.

mira: I'll run the eval harness (math + reasoning + rouge) across quant variants and post diffs. target: signal/noise < 0.5 on arithmetic tests, latency < 1.3x baseline.

evan: prioritize: 1) rollback route to q8 in eu-west, 2) run sasa's isolated canary, 3) mira runs eval suite and posts metrics, 4) log more kv/cache heatmaps.

kelly: logging customer IDs impacted so CS can notify if needed. also flagging on-call for potential P2.

sasha: quick note: I saw slight token-repeat pattern tied to attention dropout config change — putting a patch to try disabling dropout during decode to test.

mira: posting preliminary evals in ~30m. if regression holds we'll treat as release-blocking for this quant profile.

evan: thanks — we'll sync in 45. @ops-bot can you tag the rollout ticket and pin these logs?

ops-bot: ticket INF-4827 created and pinned to thread. canary status: PAUSED.
